programmes.d: Cardi B deals with her next-level fame, Yandy tries to maintain family harmony while Mendeecees is in prison, and Juelz prepares for a return to music.
Bianca tries keeping it professional with an old flame, Kimbella worries Juelz is making more than beats in the studio, and Remy Ma doesn't want her kids pursuing music.
Sky wants to kick Bianca off Drewski's latest track, J. Adrienne questions her relationship with Snoop, and tensions within Mendeecees's family take a toll on Kim.
Shelah's retreat sparks an emotional debate. Amara contends with a personal tragedy. Trina's family getaway takes a dark turn. The 305 gathers to celebrate Ace's new music.

Bill pops up at Sukihana's grand opening. Amara receives devastating news about her father. Florence and Marlon put it all on the table. Trina tries to find a measure of peace. Princess, Neri, and Shelah struggle through a difficult conversation.

Trina's team clashes over recent mishaps, while Raymond plots a huge surprise. Trick Daddy makes headlines. Allan pays Amara a visit. Tragedy strikes as Florence prepares for divorce. N.O.R.E. and Neri celebrate a milestone.

Masika hires Misster Ray to plan an event, only to get caught in the crossfire. Concerns mount over Teairra's self-destructive behavior. A1 considers a collaboration with Keyshia Cole. Brooke and Booby hatch a plan to teach Marcus a lesson.

Mayhem erupts at Safaree and Chanel's music video shoot. Misster Ray's attempt to make nice with Masika leads to a wild encounter with Zell. A betrayed Teairra lashes out at Cisco, Moniece, and Nia. Keyshia gets caught in the middle of a marital spat.

Shocking allegations blow up Masika and Nia's dinner for Zell and Misster Ray. Teairra and Cisco's shopping trip ends in tears. Moniece struggles with 'the other woman' in her relationship. Booby worries about Keyshia's response to his latest move.

After Meda's revelation at Spice's dinner, Sierra wrestles with whether or not to tell Kendra. Rasheeda's daddy issues resurface when he plans an unexpected visit. Joc & Kendra realize that dragging their feet to the alter may have caused more problems.

Renni's world crashes down around her after getting some troubling news. With the wedding rapidly approaching, Kendra struggles to keep everything on track, while the only thing Joc needs to borrow is time as he races for the altar.

Karlie gets back to her music, but her new single has Spice seeing red. Renni struggles to cope after her mother's accident. Bambi shows Momma Dee she's the reigning Queen in the Richardson household. And Joc & Kendra's wedding bliss may be cut short.

Karlie steps back into the music scene, but a premature release party might keep her song off the charts. Sierra & Eric's trip to New York takes a turn. Kendra's honeymoon is over when Bambi & Erica reveal Meda isn't the only skeleton in Joc's closet.

Sierra finds herself feeling home alone after the robbery. Spice's Graci Noir fashion show debut is a runway success, but Shekinah makes a mess when she puts Meda in the line of fire. The reality of his newly single life finally starts to hit Safaree.

With Samantha in the ATL, Mendeecees tries to mend her and Yandy's relationship. Joc & Kendra get some spiritual guidance. Eric tries to get out of the dog house with Sierra. Renni continues to hold her family down while her mom is in the hospital.

Sierra's post-engagement bliss becomes a case of cold feet. Safaree questions his son's looks. Rasheeda's daddy issues come to a head when Harold visits. The girls rally around Renni after the death of her mother. The Meda rumors continue to haunt Kendra.
Cardi B finds out Swift's girlfriend is trash-talking her, Samantha and Erika accuse Yandy of spreading lies, and J. Adrienne confronts Sofi at her audition.
Drewski and Sky reach an impasse over his relationship with Bianca, Juju and Cam'ron decide to take a major step together, and Mariahlynn reconsiders signing with DJ Self.
